howToExport: Open Revolut (app or web), select the account you budget with and open its Statement option.
Choose the spreadsheet format (CSV / Excel) instead of PDF, and the period you want to import.
Generate and download the file; repeat per month if you keep monthly statements.
Drop the file (or several months at once) into the tool above.
knownQuirks: Card payments that haven't settled are exported with an empty Completed Date and State PENDING; importing them creates transactions that later change or vanish. The preset drops PENDING, REVERTED, DECLINED and FAILED rows.
Fees sit in a separate Fee column (for example on currency exchanges), so Amount alone doesn't match your balance. The preset subtracts the fee from each amount.
One statement can mix currencies: an exchange creates rows in both. A YNAB account holds a single currency, so the most frequent one is kept and you can pick another.
Dates include the time (2024-03-02 09:15:22); the preset writes plain YYYY-MM-DD dates using the settled Completed Date.
